You cannot beat it for grilling. The heat and distance from the coal seem to be perfect. My major concern is the hook on the inside cover is really only accessible if you put it down at 9:00 or 3:00 o'clock. It then makes accessing the ash pot hard to see.  

Also when you hang the food grate to place the charcoal chimney on the coal grate, you are really hampered from access.  A permanent place to hang the kettle cover or tip it open on a hinge-like device would have been great. 

Also to keep the top vent away from your face, and to enable hanging the cover without twisting your hand etc., you now have to read the thermometer sideways.  In other words, unless I have really blown the assembly, there are some design flaws I feel should be addressed.

I especially like the lid/cover hook that gives a safe place to put the hot lid.  I am very pleased with my cooking experience and i am hoping to have long life from the heavy duty construction.  The only thing i would like so far is a pivot to rotate the grilling surface so i could mov the food without picking it up too soon.  Over all a good experience.  How well it holds up only time will tell.

Results.ReviewText:
Construction: The little tabs that support the grills, & cover are way to short for holding them on securely. The inside grills slide back and forth falling off easily and the cover is hard to locate when moving from cooking to the side storage position. It is to bad the company doesn't make the storage of the top like it does on the other models add the wire rim holder. Other than that it cooks like a dream if used properly...could be a bit easier to clean but it is way better the any other grills. The ash catcher is great although with the spring handle nubs not clicking in to a positive lock notch it can be a simple task of watching to align just right. The one touch cleaning system isn't all that it is cracked up to be, it doesn't clean all of the residue as advertised; you have to either take a brush to finish cleaning out the bowl and remove the spent coals your self. 
I would give it a 4 or 5 after using it maybe a little conservative but it is a nice product.

When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. 14407001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
